meta.title: The Kinds of Observation Surface
meta.subtitle: State through lookups and subscriptions · one message through diagnostics · numbers through meters

components.label: status surface
components.sublabel: the value now and its changes

cards.title: They are consumed differently
items: The status surface is for reading the current value or receiving changes in order. A subscription stays open until cancelled, so run it somewhere tied to the host's lifetime.
Diagnostics are for tracing one message and meters for gathering dashboard numbers. There is no surface that delivers runtime events to a handler.
